or u. mahAº or uDDAmarezvaraº The Uḍḍīśa below is also called Uḍḍāmara in some mss.; in some mss. the two texts are identical.

Ramsingh 1024 (5) (Uḍḍāmareśvaratantra). 1071. RASB. VIII. A. 5848. SSPC. I. J. 52. TD. XX. Sup. no. 1002. Q. in Dakṣiṇāmūrti's Uddhārako1śa (Lahore edn. I. 22. 37. II. 18. III. 59. VII. 67); ref. to by Premanidhi in his Kāmyadīpadānapaddhati, Nepal II. p. 141.
